title: Fractions: Equivalence, Comparing and Adding
summary: Equivalent fractions, comparing fractions, and adding and subtracting them with common denominators.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 8: Working with Fractions
Earlier NCERT Ch 2: Fractions and Decimals

objectives: I can compare and order fractions.
I can add and subtract fractions using a common denominator.
misconceptions: A bigger denominator means a bigger fraction.
To add fractions, add the tops and add the bottoms.
